trailer/nine-dragon.prompt: Genre: cinematic trip-hop trailer music with traditional Chinese instruments, neon noir. BPM: 80. Key: D minor pentatonic. Instrumental only, no vocals, no singing, no words. A short teaser for a colossal vertical neon city at night in the rain, Kowloon Walled City meets Chongqing. Structure: opens quiet with soft rain, a lone guzheng phrase and a low analog synth drone; after a few seconds a deep drum hit and the beat drops: slow dusty trip-hop breakbeat drums, a deep warm analog synth bass line, an erhu melody soaring over pipa tremolo and shimmering guzheng arpeggios; the energy rises to a big peak; ends on one massive hit with a gong and a long ringing tail. Production: modern cinematic trailer mix, wide stereo, deep sub bass, crisp punchy drums, big reverb, rain texture.
